question: In the pinned released WOD-E2E scoring function, does a maximum scalar score imply a true same-reference trust flag, and do equal evaluated endpoints constrain intermediate predicted waypoints?
rationale: Source qualification revealed separate time-wise maximum and same-reference trust predicates. Run a bounded native-code semantics probe before using the metric in any later comparison. This does not admit the missing complete-work case or reopen prior synthetic baseline studies.
exposure: Paper v3, source code, tutorial and upstream tests read before freeze; expected authored outcomes anticipated. Upstream tests contain selected sample trajectory and score outcomes, already exposed. No complete prediction pair, dataset split, or human work record acquired.

domain.defaults: Native scorer defaults, including outside-region floor4; no modification

checks: All six native scores and flags match the declared exact expectations to abs1e-12.
Batch evaluation, singleton evaluation and reversed batch agree per case.
All six permutations of all three paired reference trajectories/scores agree per case.
Maximum deviation from reference0 at intermediate time differs for same_reference and intermediate_excursion while both reported metrics match.
Reject a changed native source hash before import.
failure_rule: Any mismatch is retained; do not repair the source, alter cases or promote an unverified interpretation. Stop after these finite cases.
nonclaims: Not physically qualified trajectories or safety evidence
Not a complete WOD evaluator or server reproduction
Not empirical ranking impact, novelty, upstream defect, independent scientific replication or complete-work advantage
Not a correction to the published intended metric
